title: BBC Learning English from the News 2025 — Quiz 8
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q071_drip_feed
elements.title: Instead of announcing everything at once, the company chose to ___ the details over several weeks.

elements.name: q072_point_fingers
elements.title: Instead of trying to fix the mistake, the managers started to ___ at one another.

elements.name: q073_swirl
elements.title: Different rumours continued to ___ as people speculated about why the director had left.

elements.name: q074_still_remains_unanswered
elements.title: Weeks later, the question of how the fire started ___. No explanation has been offered.

elements.name: q075_hold_up
elements.title: The explanation sounded convincing initially, but would it ___ when checked against the records?

elements.name: q076_speak_out
elements.title: Several employees decided to ___ publicly about unsafe conditions at work.

elements.name: q077_catch_someone_by_surprise
elements.title: Which expression means “happen unexpectedly enough to surprise someone”?

elements.name: q078_face_scrutiny
elements.title: After the error was discovered, the company's accounts began to ___ from independent auditors.

elements.name: q079_sweltering
elements.title: The office was ___ after the air conditioning broke during the heatwave.

elements.name: q080_take_the_brunt_of
elements.title: The village nearest the coast will ___ the storm, experiencing the worst damage.
